text: {"features":[{"name":"Education level","description":"The extent to which the letter presents academic preparation that meets or exceeds the role's stated educational preferences.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents only a relevant bachelor's degree, with no indication of advanced study."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant bachelor's degree and frames it as direct technical preparation for the work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree or comparable graduate study."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant doctoral degree or other unusually advanced technical study."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents an advanced research degree and explicitly connects that preparation to the role's technical demands."}]},{"name":"Experience depth","description":"How much professional software engineering maturity the letter demonstrates through years of work, production exposure, and service ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only baseline professional experience, with relatively limited years or scope across production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter meets or modestly exceeds the baseline, but the production scope described remains fairly narrow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid mid-level experience through several years of work and multiple production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong breadth through repeated testing, maintenance, and launches across several production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows especially deep experience for this sample, combining many years with substantial multi-service production ownership."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows strong, role-relevant experience building production systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go only as one language among several, without indicating meaningful depth or ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter indicates regular Go use, but does not show that Go is central to the applicant's work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a principal or daily language for production software development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter links Go to backend or infrastructure systems the applicant designed, maintained, or owned."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong role-specific Go expertise by tying sustained Go backend ownership to security or automation systems."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows strong, production-ready Python experience relevant to tooling, automation, or AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python experience at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python only lightly, such as generic familiarity or occasional scripting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular Python use for tooling, services, automation, or internal workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as production-grade, with clear ownership of services, tooling, or well-engineered code."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep Python strength that is central to automation or AI-agent work and clearly trusted in production."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates practical fluency with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of data-structure or algorithmic strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter makes a generic claim about algorithmic ability without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one specific example of using algorithms or structure choice to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong practical fluency through a meaningful technical example tied to performance, scaling, or system simplification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates especially sophisticated algorithmic thinking by showing how a hard problem was made tractable through a well-chosen approach."}]},{"name":"AI maturity","description":"How well the letter shows practical, production-minded experience building with AI systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention any AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI only as a broad interest or unspecified exposure."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant shipped AI or LLM-based features, but gives little sense of production discipline."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes production AI work together with explicit attention to evaluation, reliability, trust, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows mature applied AI judgment by explaining how production AI systems were constrained, evaluated, or hardened for dependable use."}]},{"name":"Security assessment skill","description":"How convincingly the letter shows the applicant can evaluate systems for security weaknesses and validate fixes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of security assessment experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter suggests general security interest or informal review work, but not concrete assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states experience with recognizable assessment methods such as threat modeling, code review, or formal security reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes structured assessments with clear methods and follow-through such as validating fixes or documenting findings."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong assessment maturity by framing reviews as systematic analysis of attack surface, implementation gaps, and verified remediation."}]},{"name":"Triage automation ownership","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on ownership of automating vulnerability intake, triage, or routing workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention vulnerability handling or triage automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter refers vaguely to security automation, but not to concrete vulnerability-triage work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states experience automating vulnerability intake, classification, deduplication, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly describes building or owning a vulnerability-triage pipeline that reduced manual queue work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents vulnerability-handling automation as a major achievement with operational detail and clear gains in security-team capacity."}]},{"name":"Agent architecture","description":"How convincingly the letter shows the applicant can design agentic systems with appropriate control boundaries.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of agentic tooling or agent-based system design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents or automation only vaguely, without explaining architecture or responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states experience designing agentic pipelines or tools that combine Python and Go."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains how agents and services interact, including bounded actions, permissions, constraints, or auditing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows sophisticated security-oriented agent design, with explicit guardrails, control surfaces, and operational reasoning."}]},{"name":"Role understanding","description":"How clearly the letter shows an accurate grasp of the specific work this Information Security Engineering role involves.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads as a generic software-engineering application with little evidence of understanding this role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter references security or scale in broad terms, but does not engage the job's concrete responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter connects the applicant to at least one core responsibility such as secure development, vulnerability handling, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows a clear grasp of the role's central problem of scaling security processes through tooling for other teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter precisely connects multiple listed responsibilities, such as agentic tooling, vulnerability triage, AI agents, and secure-development enablement."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How strongly the letter shows motivation to build foundational systems whose benefits compound across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter focuses mainly on personal growth or isolated product work rather than broad organizational impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gestures at scale or foundational work, but that theme is not developed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in engineering work whose benefits reach more than one team or surface."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly emphasizes foundational tooling or infrastructure with broad downstream leverage."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes cross-organizational leverage a defining theme and ties it directly to why this role matters."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping internal users do the right thing more easily.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no sense of thinking about developer workflows or internal users."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints at helping others indirectly, but does not frame security work around user enablement."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter says security should reduce manual burden or make the secure path easier."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly presents security tooling as a way to help developers or security engineers work more effectively."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter strongly centers user enablement, describing security as embedded support and better defaults rather than after-the-fact policing."}]},{"name":"Motivation specificity","description":"How convincing and role-specific the applicant's stated reason for applying feels.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives generic enthusiasm that could fit almost any software-engineering opening."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some interest in Google, security, or scale, but the reason remains broad."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter offers a plausible reason for applying and loosely ties it to past experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives a convincing, role-specific motivation grounded in the applicant's values or career direction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a highly distinctive and compelling why-this-role narrative that feels deeply consistent with the experience described."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter supports claims with concrete, observable examples rather than broad assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad claims with little concrete evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few specifics such as years, languages, or job titles, but little detail about substantive work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives several concrete examples of projects, systems, or responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter backs most major claims with specific technical examples or named types of work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes nearly every major claim concrete through detailed, observable examples that let the reader infer capability."}]},{"name":"Impact articulation","description":"How clearly the letter explains the results or value created by the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes activities without indicating what changed or why the work mattered."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies usefulness, but gives little sense of concrete outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions credible outcomes such as reduced manual work, improved performance, or better routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter ties multiple examples to clear effects on team efficiency, system behavior, or security posture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly translates work into meaningful operational impact or scaled capacity gains for others."}]},{"name":"Security engagement","description":"How much independent, externally visible security development the letter shows through practice or credentials outside routine job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no independent security practice, credential, or external signal."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows only light independent security interest without a strong signal of commitment."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter includes a moderate external signal such as recurring capture-the-flag participation or a baseline security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a strong hands-on signal such as OSCP or notably strong competitive capture-the-flag performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows sustained, high-conviction independent security development through multiple strong signals or one exceptionally demanding hands-on signal described with seriousness."}]},{"name":"Engineering initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed technical work beyond the applicant's core job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of self-directed technical work outside normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small personal project or light open-source activity with limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows steady initiative through maintained side projects, occasional upstream patches, or modest ongoing builds."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial initiative through a technically ambitious side system or active open-source maintainership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows exceptional self-direction through a sustained, technically demanding project or widely used open-source stewardship with real responsibility."}]},{"name":"Structural coherence","description":"How easy the letter is to follow as a logically organized case for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter is hard to follow because ideas are disjointed, abruptly presented, or poorly sequenced."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a recognizable structure, but the flow is rough, choppy, or uneven."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally easy to follow, though some sections feel formulaic, abrupt, or mechanically assembled."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is well organized, with a clear progression from background to evidence to motivation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally cohesive and readable, using structure and transitions to build a persuasive case with very little friction."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level in spelling, grammar, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent spelling, grammar, or typographical errors that noticeably undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has several conspicuous errors that distract the reader, even though the meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter has occasional errors or awkward phrasing, but remains professionally acceptable overall."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is cleanly written with only minor, easily overlooked mistakes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is essentially error-free and polished throughout."}]}]}
